title: For reading raw.githubusercontent.com, could use `gh` cli

messages.text: For reading raw.githubusercontent.com, could use `gh` cli

Yes: GitHub files, raw.githubusercontent.com included, are read with the gh CLI; that is already a standing rule (memory note github-via-gh, from T-071).
- gh is logged in on this Mac, so agents get the higher rate limit; read-only only.
- The two agents reading WebKit source right now (fix-nav-fade, fix-scroll-cb) got the reminder with the exact command.
- If you just saw a permission prompt for raw.githubusercontent.com, deny it; the agent then uses gh.

What you need to do: nothing.
i was some agents request me to read them. let's investigate and do more harden them.

Found it: our own guard was set to "ask" for GitHub, so every agent that forgot the gh rule landed on you as a permission prompt.

- Who: since your gh rule (T-071, 4 Oct), only one agent slipped: a helper of fix-nav-fade, 2 reads of WebKit source at 05:56Z today. Before the rule, ~60 agents made ~100 direct GitHub reads.
- Why you saw it: an earlier guard fix (the curl rate-limit incident, I-115) made plain web reads (WebFetch) and curl to GitHub "ask the user" instead of "refuse".
- Workaround now: I reminded fix-nav-fade and its helper to use gh. If a GitHub prompt appears, press No; the agent then switches to gh.
- Long-term (incident I-200, the "refuse, point to gh" fix; owner ts-i200):
  - GitHub reads outside gh get refused at once, with a message telling the agent the gh command.
  - A rule line goes into the 3 agent types that can browse.
  - Tests cover it. Docs sites (w3c.github.io etc.) stay open.
- After it lands you should see no more GitHub read prompts.

What you need to do
- Approve the edit prompts for .claude/settings.json and the guard hook when ts-i200 asks (that is this change).
